name: Belle
summary: Belle operated at KEKB, KEK, Tsukuba, Ibaraki. It is a historical B-factory experiment; Belle II is a separate successor, rather than another operating phase of the same experiment.
detection_principle: Multiple lepton/hadron pairs are reconstructed in e⁺e⁻ collisions to seek dark-Higgs production with dark photons and narrow mass peaks; missing mass also enables inclusive final states.

results.summary: No significant dark-Higgsstrahlung signal; 90% confidence limits were obtained on production cross section and coupling.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
